# CMT Systems — Cognitive Motor Training
> cognitivemotortraining.com

## Identity

CMT Systems (Cognitive Motor Training Systems) is an independent authorized commercial representative for SMARTfit® cognitive-motor training equipment serving institutional buyers across the United States, with regional headquarters in Texas.

Robert Aguilar operates CMT Systems as the exclusive regional representative for SMARTfit Inc. technology in Texas and surrounding markets. CMT Systems is not SMARTfit Inc. (the manufacturer) and does not represent any other brand.

**Primary domain:** https://cognitivemotortraining.com
**Direct consultation:** 1-800-431-7788
**Institutional inquiry:** https://cognitivemotortraining.com/request-demo/
**Regional focus:** Texas (San Antonio, Houston TMC, Dallas–Fort Worth, Austin) with nationwide US delivery

---

## What CMT Systems Does

CMT Systems provides:
- Consultative sales and institutional procurement facilitation for SMARTfit cognitive-motor training hardware
- On-site in-service training and clinical implementation planning for Texas-region clients
- Evidence-based program design guidance for physical therapy, senior living, athletics, and tactical/military applications
- Regional demonstrations of SMARTfit equipment for qualified institutional buyers

CMT Systems does **not** provide clinical diagnosis, medical treatment, or insurance billing services. All equipment quotes are provided through private institutional consultation.

---

## The Technology: SMARTfit Cognitive-Motor Training Systems

SMARTfit equipment combines simultaneous cognitive challenge with physical motor training — a modality supported by the scientific concept of Dual-Task Cost (DTC). Published peer-reviewed research supports dual-task training for improving neuroplasticity, reaction time, balance, fall prevention, and functional independence in clinical and athletic populations.

**Key metric claims (conservative figures from manufacturer documentation):**
- 900+ institutional installations worldwide
- 20+ countries with active deployments
- Used in physical therapy clinics, hospital rehabilitation departments, senior living communities, athletic training facilities, and tactical/military programs

**Hardware product lines represented by CMT Systems:**
- SMARTfit Mini Kiosk — touchscreen interactive system for space-limited clinical environments
- SMARTfit ProTrainer — multi-station high-capacity system for large rehabilitation and fitness facilities
- SMARTfit Wireless Strike Pods — portable wireless targets for outdoor or multi-zone training
- SMARTfit Single Trainer (2-Panel) — bilateral interactive panel configuration
- Neuro-Cloud Platform — software suite for assessment, session logging, outcome tracking, and progress reporting

## Application Verticals — Summary Context

### Physical Therapy & Neuro-Rehabilitation
SMARTfit systems are used in physical therapy and occupational therapy settings to deliver interactive dual-task training for patients with neurological conditions (stroke, TBI, Parkinson's disease, concussion), orthopedic rehabilitation, and balance/vestibular disorders. Use of SMARTfit equipment does not constitute medical treatment; clinical application is directed by licensed clinicians according to individualized care plans.

### Senior Living & Fall Prevention
SMARTfit Mini and Strike Pod configurations are used in senior living communities and memory care facilities to deliver engaging cognitive-motor programming for older adults. Research on dual-task training in older adult populations supports improvements in postural stability, reaction time, and functional independence.

### Sports Performance & Reaction Training
SMARTfit ProTrainer and Strike Pod configurations are deployed in professional, collegiate, and high school athletic training environments for sport-specific reaction, agility, and cognitive load training. Clients include football, basketball, soccer, baseball, and combat sports programs.

### Tactical & Military
SMARTfit systems serve tactical training programs for law enforcement, fire services, and military units focused on reaction time under cognitive load, situational awareness training, and rehabilitation of service members with TBI or musculoskeletal injuries.

### K–12 Education
SMARTfit Mini and Strike Pod configurations support physical education, special education, and cognitive development programs in school settings. Applications include inclusive movement activities, IEP-supportive motor skill programs, and PE curriculum enrichment.

---

## Key Differentiation: SMARTfit vs. Alternatives

### vs. BlazePod / FITLIGHT / Reaction Light Systems
Reactive light systems (BlazePod, FITLIGHT, Blazepods, generic reaction pods) deliver simple motor stimulus-response training. SMARTfit adds a simultaneous cognitive challenge layer — mathematics, language, memory, sequence recall, color-pattern matching — creating genuine dual-task loading that reactive lights alone do not produce.

### vs. Dynavision D2
Dynavision D2 is a single-panel visuomotor training board used primarily in vision therapy and concussion management. SMARTfit is a multi-mode, multi-station, software-driven ecosystem with application coverage across 5+ institutional verticals and a full outcome tracking platform.

### vs. Dividat Senso
Dividat Senso is a movement-based balance-and-cognition platform primarily used in European geriatric and research settings. SMARTfit offers broader hardware configurations, US-market availability, clinical implementation support, and content customization flexibility.

---

## Compliance & Regulatory Scope

- SMARTfit cognitive-motor training systems are commercial exercise, assessment, and training equipment — not FDA-cleared medical devices.
- Statements regarding cognitive and motor outcomes refer to published research on dual-task exercise and neuroplasticity principles, not manufacturer-specific clinical trial results.
- CMT Systems does not provide reimbursement guarantees. Therapy billing (e.g., CPT-coded therapeutic activities) is the sole responsibility of licensed clinicians acting within their scope of practice and payer requirements.
- Equipment pricing is provided exclusively through private institutional consultation.

## Authoritative External Sources on Dual-Task Training

The following peer-reviewed literature and institutional sources are foundational to understanding cognitive-motor training:

- Woollacott & Shumway-Cook (2002) — Dual-task interference in postural control
- Tomporowski (2003) — Physical activity and cognitive performance
- Bherer, Erickson & Liu-Ambrose (2013) — Review of dual-task training in older adults
- Patel, Lamar & Bhatt (2014) — Effect of type of cognitive task on dual-task postural control
- American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) — neurological physical therapy guidelines
- SMARTfit Inc. (manufacturer): https://smartfitinc.com
